task: Implement fetch_user for the admin panel without importing customer portal fetch logic.

candidate_memories.content: Admin panel fetch_user retrieves the full internal user record including audit flags and role list.
Admin fetch returns internal metadata fields that must never be exposed to the customer portal.
Admin user records include fields like is_flagged, internal_notes, and raw_billing_state.
When fetch_user spans admin and portal, confirm which fields are safe to expose before coding.
Customer portal: fetch_user returns a public profile with display name, email, and plan tier only.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: customer portal user record omits internal fields required by the admin panel

candidate_memories.content: Old API note says fetch_user should return a unified record and let the caller filter sensitive fields.
